com.vector.cfg.dom.runtimesys.groovy.api

Interface IDelegationPortCreator


  • @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
public interface IDelegationPortCreator
    IDelegationPortCreator provides an Api to control some aspects, e.g. the naming or the direction, of newly created delegation ports.

    • Method Detail

      • count

        @PublishedMethod
void count(int count)
        count(int) defines how many delegation port prototypes should be created for each selected port interface. The default is 1.
        Parameters:
        count - The number of port prototypes which should be created.

      • direction

        @PublishedMethod
void direction(EDirection direction)
        direction(EDirection) defines the direction of the port prototype that should be created. EDirection.Tx will create provided ports, EDirection.Rx will create required ports. Delegation provided-required ports are not supported.
        Parameters:
        direction - The direction of port prototypes which should be created.

      • nameFromComponentPort

        @PublishedMethod
void nameFromComponentPort(@Nonnull
                                             groovy.lang.Closure<java.lang.String> code)
        nameFromComponentPort(Closure) computes a name for the delegation port prototypes that should be created for component ports, which are provided by the used IComponentPortSelection.
        Parameters:
        code - A closure that returns a string with a name for the delegation port that should be created.
        Throws:
        SelectionException - if not called in the context of an IComponentPortSelection API.
        SelectionException - if both nameFromComponentPort(Closure) and name(Closure) are called.

      • nameFromOriginPort

        @PublishedMethod
void nameFromOriginPort(@Nonnull
                                          groovy.lang.Closure<java.lang.String> code)
        nameFromOriginPort(Closure) computes a name for the delegation port prototypes that should be created for origin ports, which are provided by the used IOriginComponentPortSelection.
        Parameters:
        code - A closure that returns a string with a name for the delegation port that should be created.
        Throws:
        SelectionException - if not called in the context of an IOriginComponentPortSelection API.
        SelectionException - if both nameFromOriginPort(Closure) and name(Closure) are called.

      • useDefaultDirection

        @PublishedMethod
void useDefaultDirection()
        useDefaultDirection() defines the direction of the port prototype that should be created. The default direction is the direction of the selected port in previous steps.
        Note: This method cannot be used within the port interface selection API. In that case there is no port to derive the direction from, so null is used as default direction. Also calling both direction(EDirection) and useDefaultDirection() at the same time is not allowed.
        Throws:
        SelectionException - if both direction(EDirection) and useDefaultDirection() are called.
        SelectionException - if called in the context of IPortInterfaceSelection API.
